name: tel99-cloud-autonomy
description: TEL99 read-only autonomy: select one authorised GitHub mission and drive the existing Analyst -> Developer -> Verifier team on an isolated branch. No permanent automation is enabled by this file.

repository.description: GitHub repository (owner/name) the missions are read from. Must be in the TEL99 allowlist.

mission_label.description: Only issues carrying this label are eligible. Other labels are ignored.

base_branch.description: Branch the work branch is cut from. Protected branches are rejected.

work_branch_prefix.description: Prefix for the isolated work branch created for each mission.

max_concurrent_missions.description: Hard cap. The schema allows only 1: one active mission at a time.

max_runtime_seconds.description: Deadline for the whole run. Children are stopped when it is reached.

quota_min_remaining.description: Refuse to start when the free daily conversation quota has less than this left.

dry_run.description: When true, select and validate a mission but start no conversation. Activation flips this to false.
